fees.notes: International total payable fee for the entire programme per UOC official International Fees Structure (includes registration RM2,000, processing RM1,500, administration RM8,000/RM5,000 ODL, EMGS RM2,800 and resource fees); per-year amount not published. Source: https://cyberjaya.edu.my/admission/fees/international-fees-structure (fetched 2026-09-18)

requirements.general: Any of these: SPM: Pass SPM or Equivalent with 3 credits in the following subjects*: Pass in English and Credits in Mathematics and ONE Science subject (Biology/Chemistry/ Physics/General Science) AND Any other 1 subject STPM: Pass with a Grade C (GPA 2.00) in one subject* Sijil Tinggi Agama Malaysia (STAM): Pass with at least Maqbul grade* UEC: Pass English or Bahasa Malaysia at SPM/equivalent and obtain a minimum Grade B in 3 UEC subjects as below: Mathematics or ONE Science subject (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, General Science); AND Any other TWO subjects (including English and/or Bahasa Malaysia) IGCSE (O-level): Pass with credits (Grade C) in the following subjects*: Mathematics or ONE Science subject (Biology/Chemistry/ Physics/General Science) AND Any other 1 subject Other certificate (Level 3, MQF): Minimum CGPA 2.00* Sijil Kemahiran Malaysia Tahap 3 (SKM Level 3) / Sivil Vokasional Malaysia in the relevant field: The programme is fully accredited by MQA/recognised by the Malaysian government Progression into a related field of study Undergoes a relevant bridging programme provided by the University English Proficiency (For International Students): MUET Band 3 or CEFR (High Bl) *A pass in English and a credit in Mathematics or ONE Science subject at SPM level or equivalent can be waived should any other higher qualifications contain those subjects with an equivalent or higher achievement.

description: يهدف برنامج دبلوم في السلامة والصحة المهنية إلى إعداد كوادر مؤهلة لتطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة في بيئات العمل المختلفة، والحد من المخاطر المهنية وحماية العاملين والممتلكات والبيئة. يركز البرنامج على تقييم المخاطر، وإدارة السلامة، والاستجابة للطوارئ، والصحة المهنية، والتشريعات والأنظمة المتعلقة بالسلامة. كما يكتسب الطلبة مهارات استخدام معدات السلامة وإعداد خطط الوقاية والتفتيش وإدارة الحوادث، بما يؤهلهم للعمل في مختلف القطاعات الصناعية والخدمية.
